name: PPO

deltas.change: introduce a learned state-value V_head (or shared critic) to compute Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE); advantages A_t = sum_{l=0}^{T-t} (gamma*lambda)^l delta_{t+l} where delta_t = r_t + gamma*V(s_{t+1}) - V(s_t); the group-mean baseline of GRPO is REPLACED by V(s_t).
lambda in (0,1] GAE bias-variance trade-off; typical value 0.95. GRPO has no lambda (group mean is the baseline; advantage is r - mean(r_group)).

PPO-style ratio clipping r_t(theta) in [1-eps, 1+eps] with eps=0.2 symmetric (canonical leaf pinned at clip_eps_low=0.2, clip_eps_high=0.2); same as REINFORCE+clip, but the value head provides the variance-reduction that REINFORCE lacks.
K=4 epochs over the same rollout buffer per gradient step (canonical leaf pinned at epochs_per_prompt=4); GRPO uses K=1 by default.

notes: Iter-78 vein (d): PPO appears in experiments/results/experiment_ledger.tsv (1 wandb run, tinker-rl-lab-world-class / v9eesnqc / Qwen3.5-4B / gsm8k / G=30) but had no delta_*.json entry. PPO is the grandparent algorithm of GRPO: GRPO is essentially PPO with the value head removed and replaced by a per-prompt group-mean baseline, the ratio clip retained, and K=1 epoch. The 'base' field is set to 'grpo' for registry consistency (every entry declares a base) even though semantically GRPO is a SPECIALIZATION of PPO. Measured block intentionally null: only 1 wandb PPO run exists in the worktree (Qwen3.5-4B / gsm8k), and it is cross-stack relative to the N2 GRPO reference run (different project, different sampler, no paired-arm counterfactual); same-stack arm criterion (same model + task + sampler + RLHF pipeline with only the V_head added) is not yet met. Adding a measured row would be fabricatory. Expected-effects block below carries the registry's paper-derived predictions so future auditors can score the (expected, measured) pair once a same-stack PPO arm lands.

expected_effects.rationale: PPO's learned V_head reduces within-group zero-variance probability because GAE reweights per-token advantages rather than collapsing to a scalar group mean; predicted lower ZVF (more within-group dispersion) on the same stack.
PPO with K=4 epochs over the same buffer should be at least reward-neutral vs GRPO K=1; the value head adds variance reduction that should not regress final reward.
On the 5-seed risk panel, PPO's learned baseline should reduce risk of zero-variance groups (variance reduction); same prediction as REINFORCE-with-baseline.
